prose: Alexander Dunlop is the author of Play Your Cards Right: A Sacred Guide to Life On Earth. Through his website at The Source Cards, Alexander is a divinatory guide helping people find their place in the fractal blueprint of reality. Does the ubiquitous 52 card deck contain mystical information akin to one's astrological chart? Tune in and find out!
